# Test fonts

`NotoSansKR-HangulSubset.ttf` — OFL subset of Noto Sans KR (variable TTF)
containing Hangul syllables used by fixture-27 Hangul smoke tests. See
`OFL.txt` in this directory. Full Noto CJK is not vendored (size); install
`fonts-noto-cjk` or point `--font-path` at a Hangul-capable face for production.
